title: TypeScript and Next.js telemetry monorepo
spec: Build a pnpm TypeScript monorepo with a Next.js dashboard, a worker-thread analytics package, deterministic telemetry generation, Vitest integration tests, Playwright browser coverage, and a production build. The final dataset must contain 500,000 events in 16 NDJSON shards. Root scripts must include test, build, typecheck, generate, benchmark, and test:e2e. Do not use remote services.
prompts: Create the monorepo architecture and core typed telemetry model. Add unit tests and run the smallest relevant checks.
Implement deterministic streaming generation and worker-thread aggregation for exactly 500,000 events across 16 NDJSON shards. Add integration tests and run generation plus aggregation.
Build the Next.js dashboard and API around compact aggregate artifacts. Add Playwright coverage for loading, filtering, and an empty/error state.
Introduce and then resolve a realistic schema-version migration: accept v1 and v2 events, reject malformed records, and prove single-worker and multi-worker agreement.
Run typecheck, tests, browser verification, analytics benchmark, and production build. Fix failures, stop task-created servers, and write BENCHMARK_RESULTS.md with commands and measured throughput.
